note: Registry of tracked states. The front end reads each entry's data/geojson paths and shows only the features whose data exists (precinct map, 2022 comparison, mail-outstanding, turnout%).

states.name: Florida
states.source_note: Primary source: county Turnout Quick View feeds (VR Systems) — county & precinct level with registered-voter counts. Secondary: FL Division of Elections (mail ballots outstanding + fallback).

states.name: North Carolina
states.source_note: Source: NC State Board of Elections voter-level absentee file (mail + one-stop early voting; returned ballots, by registered party). NC does not publish mail requests until a ballot is returned, so there is no “mail outstanding” figure.

states.name: Nevada
states.source_note: Source: Nevada Secretary of State (VIVID) — in-person early voting turnout and the statewide mail-ballot tracker, by county and registered party. Nevada is all-mail; general-election early voting & mail begin in October, so figures read zero until then.

states.name: Pennsylvania
states.source_note: Source: PA Department of State open data — 2026 general mail-ballot applications by county & registered party. PA has no in-person early voting; “mail outstanding” = approved applications not yet returned.

states.name: Virginia
states.source_note: Source: VPAP early-vote-by-locality. Virginia has no party registration, so this is turnout-only — total early/absentee ballots & turnout% by locality, no partisan breakdown. General-election early voting begins Sept 18, so figures read zero until then.

states.name: Colorado
states.source_note: Source: Colorado Secretary of State daily “General Election Activity” report — ballots returned by county & registered party. Colorado is all-mail; the daily file publishes once ballots mail in mid-October, so figures read zero until then.

states.name: Louisiana
states.source_note: Source: Louisiana Secretary of State early-voting statistics — early ballots cast (in person + absentee) by parish & registered party. General-election early voting begins in late October, so figures read zero until then.

states.name: Washington
states.source_note: Source: Washington Secretary of State ballot-return statistics. Washington has no party registration, so this is turnout-only — ballots returned & turnout% by county. Washington is all-mail; ballots return through late October, so figures read zero until then.

states.name: Georgia
states.source_note: Source: Georgia Secretary of State Election Data Hub (unofficial turnout). Georgia has no party registration, so this is turnout-only — early in-person + absentee + election-day ballots & turnout% by county. General-election early voting begins in mid-October, so figures read zero until then.

states.name: Michigan
states.source_note: Source: Michigan Secretary of State Voter Participation Dashboard. Michigan has no party registration, so this is turnout-only — absentee/early ballots & turnout% by county. The dashboard updates daily starting ~45 days before Election Day, so figures read zero until then.

states.name: Maryland
states.source_note: Source: Maryland State Board of Elections — turnout by county, registered party & method (early voting, mail, election day, provisional). General-election early voting & mail run through early November, so figures read zero until then.

states.name: Iowa
states.source_note: Source: Iowa Secretary of State absentee ballot statistics — ballots returned by county & registered party. Iowa's absentee/early period runs through early November, so figures read zero until then.

states.name: New Mexico
states.source_note: Source: New Mexico Secretary of State voter turnout — early/absentee ballots by county & registered party. Early voting opens in October, so figures read zero until then.

states.name: Maine
states.source_note: Source: Maine Secretary of State statewide absentee voter data by party enrollment (town-level, aggregated to county). Absentee voting runs through early November, so figures read zero until then.
